get.summary: Get the customization template for an OIDC subject claim for an organization
get.desc:
Gets the customization template for an OpenID Connect (OIDC) subject claim.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `read:org` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

put.summary: Set the customization template for an OIDC subject claim for an organization
put.desc:
Creates or updates the customization template for an OpenID Connect (OIDC) subject claim.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `write:org` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

include_claim_keys.description: Array of unique strings. Each claim key can only contain alphanumeric characters and underscores.
